faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Lab Technician recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the PGIMER Lab Technician position is 05 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BSc. in Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT)/BMLS or a Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT)/DMLS with a minimum course duration of 2 years. The qualification should be recognized by the State or Central Government.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Lab Technician position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Lab Technician post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 21,000/-.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Lab Technician position at PGIMER.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the PGIMER Lab Technician role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Screening Test, followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What are the important dates for the PGIMER Lab Technician recruitment?
faq.answer: Key dates include the last date for application (05 September 2026), Written Screening Test (15 September 2026), Shortlist Display (16 September 2026), and Interview (17 September 2026).

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply through online mode?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment requires an offline application. Candidates must download the application form and submit it via post as per the instructions in the notification.
